classes.label: Absolute fix
classes.comment: A fix based on some established global measuring scheme.

classes.label: Actual Flight Route
classes.comment: A flight trajectory (i.e., a sequence of track points), as determined by flight track surveillance data.

classes.label: Aircraft capacity
classes.comment: A subclass of interval-based data representing the maximum number of controllable aircraft flowing through an airspace region during some interval of time.

classes.label: Aircraft flow
classes.comment: A subclass of interval-based data representing the number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region during some interval of time.

classes.label: Aircraft flow capacity
classes.comment: A subclass of interval-based data representing the maximum controllable number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region during some interval of time, given weather and other air traffic control constraints.

classes.label: Aircraft Track Point
classes.comment: A point during a flight where various flight parameters are captured and sent (via transponder) to FAA computers.

classes.label: Airport spec
classes.comment: A specification of a set of airports.

classes.label: Airspace Flow Program (AFP)
classes.comment: A subclass of Traffic Management Initiative involving control and metering of air traffic through specified airspace volumes.

classes.label: Airspace route segment
classes.comment: A contiguous portion of an existing airspace route.

classes.label: Crew member
classes.comment: The set of inflight airline personnel operating or performing servicing functions on a flight (pilots and cabin attendants).

classes.label: GDPmodel
classes.comment: This class represents a computational delay model used in assigning times to the aircraft involved in the GDP or GS. The properties of this class correspond to parameters that are used by the delay model to compute the delay times.

classes.label: Flight
classes.comment: A single flight segment from origin to destination.

classes.label: Flight plan segment
classes.comment: A contiguous portion of a complete flight plan.

classes.label: Flight spec
classes.comment: A specification describing a set of flights.

classes.label: Ground Delay Program (GDP)
classes.comment: A Ground Delay Program (GDP) traffic management initiative (TMI). A Ground Delay Program (GDP) is a traffic management procedure where aircraft are delayed at their departure airport in order to manage demand and capacity at their arrival airport.

classes.label: Ground Stop (GS)
classes.comment: A Ground Stop (GS) traffic management initiative (TMI). A ground stop is a procedure requiring aircraft that meet specific criteria to remain on the ground. The GS may be airport specific, related to a geographical area, or equipment related.

classes.label: Miles in Trail (MIT)
classes.comment: A Miles-in-Trail (MIT) traffic management initiative (TMI) is used to apportion traffic into a manageable flow, as well as provide space for additional traffic (merging or departing) to enter the flow of traffic. Miles-in-trail describes the number of miles required between aircraft departing an airport, over a fix, at an altitude, through a sector, or on a specific route.

classes.label: Navigation element container
classes.comment: A navigation element container is a wrapper around an existing navigation element, such as a fix or a route. These containers can be sequenced together to represent flight paths and flight trajectories.

classes.label: Navigation element
classes.comment: A navigation element is a set of components that can be used to assemble a flight plan or trajectory. They include fixes, routes, airports, SID/STAR traverses, etc.

classes.label: Navigation fix
classes.comment: A designated point on the surface of the earth used for aeronautical navigation.

classes.label: Navigation path
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of navigation elements (fixes, routes, airports) representing a path through the airspace.

classes.label: Navigation SubPath
classes.comment: A contiguous portion of an existing navigation path.

classes.label: Planned flight route
classes.comment: A planned flight route is an ordered sequence of navigation elements that the pilot intends to traverse en route from origin to destination airport.

classes.label: Popup Factor Sequence
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of hourly popup factors used in specifying a Ground Delay Program (GDP).

classes.label: Program Arrival Rate Sequence
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of hourly program arrival rates used in specifying a Ground Dela Program (GDP).

classes.label: ReRoute segment
classes.comment: One of the route segment alternatives specified as part of a ReRoute traffic management initiative (TMI).

classes.label: ReRoute
classes.comment: A ReRoute is a traffic management initiative (TMI) that mandates a change in the filed flight plan for a set of specified flights. There are multiple factors that might justify a reroute, including weather, traffic congestion, unusual airspace activity, etc. The substitute flight plans route air traffic around the airspace problem area.

classes.label: Relative fix
classes.comment: A fix defined in relation to another fix.

classes.label: SIDSTARtraverse
classes.comment: A route through a SID (Standard Instrument Departure route) or a STAR (Standard Arrival Route), traversing a common route at minimum and optionally a transition route and/or an airport route.

classes.label: TFM control element
classes.comment: Any NAS entity that is potentially controlled via a TFM initiative.

classes.label: Taxipath
classes.comment: A sequence of taxiways followed by an aircraft taxiing en route to/from a runway.

classes.label: Traffic management initiative
classes.comment: A Traffic Management Initiative (TMI) is an orchestrated air traffic management procedure implemented as needed to control the flow of air traffic in the NAS based on capacity and demand.

classes.label: ARTCC
classes.comment: Air Route Traffic Control Center (ARTCC or 'Center') facility

classes.label: ARTCCtier
classes.comment: A donut-shaped geographical area surrounding a designated central ARTCC. The first tier includes all the ARTCCs that share a boundary with the designated ARTCC. The tier two ARTCCs includes the first tier ARTCCs plus those adjacent to the first tier ARCCCs. And so on.

classes.label: ATCT
classes.comment: Air Traffic Control Tower (ATCT) facility

classes.label: Air carrier
classes.comment: An entity that it licensed to operate aircraft.

classes.label: Aircraft engine manufacturer
classes.comment: A manufacturer of aircraft engines.

classes.label: Airframe manufacturer
classes.comment: A manufacturer of physical aircraft.

classes.label: Airport
classes.comment: A facility where regularly-scheduled aircraft arrive and depart.

classes.label: Airport infrastructure component
classes.comment: Part of an airport's physical infrastructure, including gates, terminals, runways, taxiways, etc.

classes.label: Airport route
classes.comment: A route within a SID or STAR that connects the common route to one of multiple airports that use the SID/STAR.

classes.label: Airport service vehicle
classes.comment: A class of vehicles that service the flights and maintain the airport physical infrastructure.

classes.label: Airspace infrastructure component
classes.comment: A defined substructure of the airspace used to manage air traffic, including sectors, SIDs, STARs, routes, etc.

classes.label: Airspace layer
classes.comment: Represents a layer within the airspace, defined by a shear-sided polygon with specified low and high altitudes.
An ordered sequence of navigation elements specifying a path through the airspace.

classes.label: Aviation industry manufacturer
classes.comment: A superclass encompassing the set of airframe and engine manufacturers.

classes.label: Common route
classes.comment: The backbone portion of a SID or STAR that is flown by all aircraft.

classes.label: Deicing pad
classes.comment: A physical location in the airport where deicing is performed.

classes.label: Deicing queue
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of aircraft awaiting deicing at a deicing pad.

classes.label: Deicing truck
classes.comment: A vehicle that holds deicing fluid and pumping equipment to support deicing.

classes.label: Federal airway
classes.comment: An airspace route that is defined by FAA and can be filed as part of a flight plan: a jet route, a Q-route, a T-Route, a Victor route.

classes.label: Gate
classes.comment: A physical interface between the aircraft and the terminal, used to board passengers and crew.

classes.label: NAS facility
classes.comment: The set of FAA and airport facilities involved in operational air traffic management (e.g. Airport, Air Route Traffic Control Center, Air Traffic Control Tower, Terminal Radar Approach Control, etc.).

classes.label: Operational runway
classes.comment: An operational runway is a named runway one used in airport operations. There are two operational runways corresponding to one physical runway; these operational runways are 180 degrees apart.

classes.label: Physical Runway
classes.comment: A physical runway, defined as a delimited rectangular surface region of the airport. Each physical runway is associated with two operational runways, 180 degrees apart.

classes.label: Radial Route
classes.comment: A route that follows a specified radial path emanating from a given fix.

classes.label: Ramp tower
classes.comment: A control tower from which ramp controllers guide aircraft movements as they enter and exit the taxiways, and arrive and leave the gates. The ramp is the area of the airport surface where planes, service vehicles, and people meet.

classes.label: Refueling truck
classes.comment: Vechicle that transports and pumps jet fuel to refuel aircraft.

classes.label: RVR measurement
classes.comment: A measurement of the distance over which a pilot of an aircraft on the centerline of a runway can see the runway surface markings delineating the runway and its centerline. RVR (Runway Visible Range) is expressed as an interval specifying the minimum and maximum number of feet visible.

classes.label: Standard Instrument Departure
classes.comment: A SID (Standard Instrument Departure) is an air traffic control coded departure procedure that has been established at certain airports to simplify clearance delivery procedures.

classes.label: SIDSTAR
classes.comment: A superclass of SID and STAR defining the properties shared by both, specifically the set of common, airport, and transition routes that comprise the SID/STAR.

classes.label: SIDSTARroute
classes.comment: A route that defines a SID or STAR.

classes.label: Standard Arrival Route
classes.comment: A STAR (Standard Terminal Arrival Route) is an air traffic control coded arrival route established for application to arriving IFR (Instrument Flight Rules) aircraft destined for certain airports.

classes.label: Sector
classes.comment: A defined volume in the the airspace of an ARTCC or TRACON whose flight traffic is typically controlled by a single controller.

classes.label: TRACON
classes.comment: Terminal Radar Approach Control (TRACON) facility

classes.label: Taxiway
classes.comment: An airport surface leading that connects the ramp area (i.e., the area in the vicinity of the gates) with the runways.

classes.label: Terminal
classes.comment: A structure on the airport surface that serves as an interface between people, baggage, and aircraft.

classes.label: Transition route
classes.comment: A route within a SID or STAR that feeds aircraft into or out from the common route of the SID/STAR. In other words, the transition route is a feeder route from the en route segment of a flight into the heart of a STAR for arrival; or an exit route from a SID funneling flights to their appropriate initial jet routes for the en route segment of flight.

classes.label: Airport Statistics Data
classes.comment: Represents a collection of airport data for a given time period, as reported by the FAA's ASPM system.

classes.label: Cloud layer
classes.comment: Represents a cloud layer, providing its bottom and top altitude, its cloud type, and its degree of coverage.

classes.label: Cloud layer profile
classes.comment: A sequence of cloud layers, ordered from the ground upward. Represents cloud conditions.

classes.label: Meteorological condition
classes.comment: A superclass over the various types of meteorological conditions.

classes.label: Meteorological condition
classes.comment: A representation of the meteorological status for the specified time period, including sky, wind, visibility, and weather subcomponents.

classes.label: Runway status data
classes.comment: This class describes a temporally-dependent set of data about the operating status of a physical runway.

classes.label: Sky condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast sky conditions, including the ceiling and information on the cloud layers present.

classes.label: Surface wind condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast surface wind conditions.

classes.label: Visibility condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast surface visibility conditions at a given airport or other reporting station.

classes.label: Weather condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast weather conditions at a given airport or other reporting station.

classes.label: Aircraft
classes.comment: A physical realization of an aircraft, produced according to the specifications defined for a specific model type.

classes.label: Aircraft communication system
classes.comment: An aircraft subsystem involving all voice and data communications functions.

classes.label: Aircraft engine
classes.comment: An aircraft engine is the component of the propulsion system for an aircraft that generates mechanical power.

classes.label: Aircraft model
classes.comment: An aircraft model represents a generic specification that describes the characteristics of a specific type of aircraft to be manufactured.

classes.label: Aircraft navigation system
classes.comment: An aircraft subsystem responsible for navigation functions.

classes.label: Aircraft subsystem
classes.comment: An engineering subsystem of an aircraft.

classes.label: Aircraft Type
classes.comment: An aircraft type represents a set of related aircraft models. Each type corresponds to one of the FAA's aircraft type designators (e.g., B777 covers all Boeing 777 models).

classes.label: Aircraft Wake Category
classes.comment: Specifies a category of aircraft according to their wake turbulance characteristics (including takeoff weight and wingspan). These categories are useful for the purpose of FAA separation assurance. See FAA Order JO 7110.659B, Wake Turbulence Recategorization, effective March 01, 2015.

classes.label: Aircraft Weight Class
classes.comment: Specifies a category of aircraft that can be used to partition aircraft according to their weight.

classes.label: Ball bearing
classes.comment: A unit assembly in an aircraft mechanical subsystem, a ball bearing is positioned between a wheel and a fixed axle, in which the rotating part and the stationary part are separated by a ring of small solid metal balls that reduce friction.

classes.label: Decomposable system
classes.comment: A complex engineering system that can be further decomposed into a set of decomposable subsystems and primitive components.

classes.label: Electrical power system
classes.comment: An aircraft subsystem responsible for generating and distributing electrical power.

classes.label: Engine Type
classes.comment: Represents different generic types of aircraft engines.

classes.label: Engineered system
classes.comment: Represents engineered systems as either decomposable or non-decomposible subsystems.

classes.label: Navigation aid
classes.comment: A navaid (navigational aid) is an engineered system on the ground that airplanes can detect based on their emission of radio signals that enable the aircraft to navigate. Modern examples include NDBs and VORs, which both transmit radio signals that aircraft can follow and home in on.

classes.label: Unit assembly
classes.comment: A primitive, non-decomposible component in an engineered system.
A two-dimensional region defined by a geographic centerpoint and radius.
A class representing a demarcated region on or above the surface of the Earth.

classes.label: Location
classes.comment: A place defined by a point or a contiguous geographic region.
A location in three-space defined by a latitude, longitude, and altitude.

classes.label: Polygon boundary
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of point locations where the last point connects back to the first point, closing the polygon.
A two-dimensional region defined by a polygonal boundary.
A two-dimensional geographic region.
A three-dimensional geographic region.

classes.label: Sequence
classes.comment: An ordered sequence of items.

classes.label: Sequenced item
classes.comment: The set of items that can be sequenced.

classes.label: Shear sided polygonal volume
classes.comment: A three-dimensional volume defined by a two-dimensional polygon plus a length component that stretches the polygon along an axis perpendicular to the polygon surface.

classes.label: Aircraft
classes.comment: A physical realization of an aircraft, produced according to the specifications defined for a specific model type.

classes.label: Aircraft Type
classes.comment: An aircraft type represents a set of related aircraft models. Each type corresponds to one of the FAA's aircraft type designators (e.g., B777 covers all Boeing 777 models).

classes.label: Flight spec
classes.comment: A specification describing a set of flights.

classes.label: Sky condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast sky conditions, including the ceiling and information on the cloud layers present.

object_properties.label: aircraft fix
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft track point with its associated navigation fix.

object_properties.label: aircraft flown
object_properties.comment: Links a flight with the actual aircraft used.

object_properties.label: aircraft type flown
object_properties.comment: Links a flight with the type of aircraft flown. The aircraft 'type' corresponds to a set of aircraft models with similar characteristics.

object_properties.label: allowed route
object_properties.comment: In a reRoute traffic management initiative, there are multiple allowed routes specified between origin and destination. This property links a ReRouteTMI with its allowed routes.

object_properties.label: alternate arrival airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the alternate arrival airport to be used in case of weather, traffic, or other unforseen contingency. The alternate airport is specified in the flight plan.

object_properties.label: arrival airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the actual arrival airport for the flight.

object_properties.label: arrival runway
object_properties.comment: Links to the actual arrival runway for the flight.

object_properties.label: arrival taxi path
object_properties.comment: Links to the taxipath followed by the flight en route to the gate.

object_properties.label: controlled NASelement
object_properties.comment: Links a traffic management initiative (TMI) to the airspace element being controlled by the TMI (e.g., an airport).

object_properties.label: departure airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the actual departure airport for the flight.

object_properties.label: departure runway
object_properties.comment: Links to the actual departure runway for the flight.

object_properties.label: departure scope
object_properties.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the departure airport(s) participating in the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_properties.label: departure taxi path
object_properties.comment: Links to the taxipath followed by the flight en route to the runway.

object_properties.label: excludes ARTCC
object_properties.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more ARTCCs (Centers) or ARTCC tiers (Centers radiating out from a give ARTCC). Any airport within the ARTCC or ARTCC tier is excluded from the set of airports covered by this airport specification.

object_properties.label: excludes airport
object_properties.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more airports. Any airport linked is excluded from the set of airports covered by this airport specification.

object_properties.label: excludes airway
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more airways (routes). Any flight that traverses a linked airway is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: excludes fix
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more navigation fixes. Any flight that traverses a linked fix is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: excludes flight
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more flights. Any linked flight is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: exempted AFP
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more Airspace Flow Program (AFP) traffic management initiatives (TMIs). Any flight included in one of the linked AFPs is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: flight exclusion spec
object_properties.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the flight(s) excluded from the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_properties.label: flight inclusion exclusion
object_properties.comment: Links a ReRoute to a specification of the flight(s) included in or excluded from the ReRoute traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_properties.label: flight inclusion spec
object_properties.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the flight(s) included in the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_properties.label: flow measurement region
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft capacity or aircraft flow to the spatial region through which flow or capacity is being monitored and measured.

object_properties.label: has actual route
object_properties.comment: Links a flight to its actual trajectory (i.e., a sequence of track points), as determined by flight track surveillance data.

object_properties.label: has crew member
object_properties.comment: Links a flight to its crew members.

object_properties.label: has navigation element
object_properties.comment: Links a container for a navigational element to the element contained.

object_properties.label: has planned route
object_properties.comment: Links a flight to a version of its flight plan. (Which version gets stored is application-dependent.) There are multiple versions of the flight plan generated and then amended during the course of the flight, starting in the pre-flight timeframe and extending through to the termination of the flight.

object_properties.label: included flights
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft flow to a specification of the flights included in the flow.

object_properties.label: includes airport
object_properties.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more airports. Any airport linked is included in the set of airports covered by this airport specification. This property allows for explicit specification of a list of specific airports; the property atm:includesAirportType allows for the the implicit specification of an entire class of airports.

object_properties.label: includes airway
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more airways (routes). Any flight that traverses a linked airway is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: includes fix
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more navigation fixes. Any flight that traverses a linked fix is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: includes flight
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more flights. Any linked flight is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_properties.label: located in sector
object_properties.comment: Links a navigation fix to the airspace sector in which that fix is located.

object_properties.label: modeled arrival rate
object_properties.comment: Links a delay model used in defining a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS) to a sequence of desired hourly aircraft arrival rates specified for the initiative.

object_properties.label: modeled by
object_properties.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a representation of the model used to design that initiative. The model contains all relevant parameters used to create the initiative.

object_properties.label: modeled pop up factor
object_properties.comment: Links a delay model used in defining a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS) to a sequence of desired hourly popup factors specified for the initiative. 'Popups' account for late-filing flights (unexpected/unplanned flights) when modeling delays as part of a traffic management initiative (TMI) design process.

object_properties.label: must have destination
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to an airport specification describing the destination airports for the flights being specified. Any flight covered by the flight specification must have as its destination one of the airports covered by the airport specification.

object_properties.label: must have origin
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to an airport specification describing the originating airports for the flights being specified. Any flight covered by the flight specification must have as its origin one of the airports covered by the airport specification.

object_properties.label: operated by
object_properties.comment: Links a flight to its carrier airline.

object_properties.label: operating carrier
object_properties.comment: Links a flight specification to one or more carrier airline(s). Each flight covered by the specification must be operated by one of these carriers.

object_properties.label: radial fix
object_properties.comment: Links to the fix through which the radial route passes.

object_properties.label: reroute constraint
object_properties.comment: Links a route segment specified as part of a ReRoute traffic management initiative (TMI) to a flight specification indicating which flights are permitted to follow the route segment.

object_properties.label: re route path
object_properties.comment: Links a route segment alternative (specified as part of a ReRoute traffic management initiative) to its associated flight plan.

Links a relative fix to the absolute fix that serves as the basis for its location. (A relative fix position is defined relative to an absolute fix position, e.g. as a vector offset from the absolute fix.)

object_properties.label: traverses SIDSTAR
object_properties.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (i.e., a specific route through a SID or STAR) to the specific SID or STAR being traversed by a given flight.

object_properties.label: uses airport route
object_properties.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (a path through a SID/STAR) to the airport route used in making the traverse.

object_properties.label: uses transition route
object_properties.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (a path through a SID/STAR) to the transition route used in making the traverse.

object_properties.label: within ARTCC
object_properties.comment: Links an airport specification to an ARTCC or ARTCC tier. Only airports within the ARTCC or ARTCC tier are covered by the specification.

object_properties.label: within airport bounding region
object_properties.comment: Links an airport specification to a circular geographic region. Only airports whose locations fall within this region satisfy the specification.

object_properties.label: adjacent sector
object_properties.comment: Links a sector to an immediately adjacent sector that shares a boundary.

object_properties.label: airport boundary
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to a representation of its perimeter boundary.

object_properties.label: airport location
object_properties.comment: Links to a geographic point designated as the airport location.

object_properties.label: arrival route airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the airport for which this route is destined.

object_properties.label: associated airport
object_properties.comment: Associates some component of airport infrastructure (runway, terminal, tower, etc.) with its airport.

object_properties.label: associated operational runway
object_properties.comment: Associates a physical runway with its two operational runways (180 degrees apart, representing approaches from either end of the physical runway).

object_properties.label: deicing pad location
object_properties.comment: Links a deicing pad with its location as a two-dimensional bounding polygon.

object_properties.label: departure route airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the airport from which this route is destined.

object_properties.label: has airport route
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_properties.label: has airspace layer geometry
object_properties.comment: Links an airspace layer with a polygon describing its location in 3-space. A sector is composed of a sequence of layers, each of which is represented as a shear-sided polygonal volume.

object_properties.label: has center geometry
object_properties.comment: Links an ARTCC to a 2-dimensional bounding polygon.

object_properties.label: has common route
object_properties.comment: Associates a common route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_properties.label: has gate
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport terminal with a aircraft gate located at that terminal.

object_properties.label: has LOA with
object_properties.comment: This property links a NAS facility to another NAS facility when there is a letter of agreement (LOA) in place between them.

object_properties.label: has queue
object_properties.comment: Links a deicing pad to its queue of aircraft waiting to be deiced.

object_properties.label: has ramp tower
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport terminal with a ramp tower that controlls the aircraft and vehicle traffic in the vicinity of that terminal.

object_properties.label: has runway
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to a physical runway for that airport.

object_properties.label: has SID
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport with the the SIDs designated to route aircraft from that airport.

object_properties.label: has STAR
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport with the the STARs designated to route aircraft to that airport.

object_properties.label: has sector layer
object_properties.comment: Links a sector to its vertically-stacked set of layers.

object_properties.label: has TRACON layer
object_properties.comment: A link between the TRACON and its geographic extent, represented as a single shear-sided polygonal volume.

object_properties.label: has taxiway
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to a taxiway for that airport.

object_properties.label: has terminal
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to a terminal for that airport.

object_properties.label: has tier
object_properties.comment: Asociates an ARTCC with the set of ARTCCs in its nth level tier. Tier 1 includes the central ARTCC plus all ARTCCs immediately adjoining the central ARTCC; tier 2 includes tier 1 plus all adjacent ARTCCs two steps away from the central ARTCC. And so on.

object_properties.label: has tower
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to an air traffic control tower for that airport.

object_properties.label: has transition route
object_properties.comment: Associates a transition route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_properties.label: includes ARTCC
object_properties.comment: A link between an ARTCC tier and the ARTCCs included in the tier.

object_properties.label: located in Center
object_properties.comment: Links a sector to the ARTCC in which the sector is located.

object_properties.label: runway footprint
object_properties.comment: Associates a physical runway with its bounding two-dimensional rectangle.

object_properties.label: runway measured
object_properties.comment: Indicates which operational runway is being measured for visible range.

object_properties.label: taxiway location
object_properties.comment: Associates a taxiway with its bounding two-dimensional rectangle.

object_properties.label: touchdown point
object_properties.comment: Links to the geographical point location that is the touchdown spot on the operational runway.

object_properties.label: within ARTCC
object_properties.comment: Links the airport to the ARTCC within which it is located.

object_properties.label: forecasting airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the airport for which the report was compiled.

object_properties.label: has airport data
object_properties.comment: Links an airport to a collection of temporally-dependent data pertinent to the airport conditions, including a variety of data collected in the ASPM system.

object_properties.label: has cloud layer profile
object_properties.comment: Links a sky condition to a representation of the cloud layers present.

object_properties.label: has meteorological condition
object_properties.comment: Links meteorological information to the collection of temporally-dependent data associated with an airport.

object_properties.label: has Meteorological report
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport with weather reports generated for that airport.

object_properties.label: has sky condition
object_properties.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the sky and cloud conditions at the reporting location..

object_properties.label: has surface wind condition
object_properties.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the surface wind conditions at the reporting location..

object_properties.label: has visibility condition
object_properties.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the surface visibility conditions at the reporting location..

object_properties.label: has weather condition
object_properties.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the weather conditions at the reporting location.

object_properties.label: runway reported on
object_properties.comment: Associates a runway status report with the physical runway being measured.

object_properties.label: runway visible range
object_properties.comment: Links a visibility condition to a runway visible range measurement class instance.

object_properties.label: designed by
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft model to the airframe manufacturer that designed the model.

object_properties.label: has aircraft engine type
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft type to the type of engine it uses.

object_properties.label: has aircraft model
object_properties.comment: Links a specific aircraft to its model.

object_properties.label: has aircraft wake category
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft model to its wake category.

object_properties.label: has aircraft weight class
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft model to its weight class.

object_properties.label: has component
object_properties.comment: Connects an engineered system to its primitive components.

object_properties.label: has subsystem
object_properties.comment: Connects an engineered system to its subsystems.

object_properties.label: is aircraft type
object_properties.comment: Links an aircraft model to its type, where the type represents a set of related models.

object_properties.label: manufactured by
object_properties.comment: A link to the entity that manufactured the system.

object_properties.label: centerpoint
object_properties.comment: Links to the center point of the 2-D circular region.

object_properties.label: hasNext
object_properties.comment: Links an item in a sequence to the subsequent item in the sequence.

object_properties.label: has polygon boundary
object_properties.comment: Links a polygonal region to its boundary representation.

object_properties.label: hasSequencedItem
object_properties.comment: Links a sequence to each of the items being sequenced.

datatype_properties.label: actual arrival time
datatype_properties.comment: The time determined by surveillance data sources to be the 'actual' time of flight arrival, versus the scheduled time or the time specified in the flight plan, etc.

datatype_properties.label: actual departure time
datatype_properties.comment: The time determined by surveillance data sources to be the 'actual' time of flight departure, versus the scheduled time or the time specified in the flight plan, etc.

datatype_properties.label: adl time
datatype_properties.comment: The timestamp of the ADL (Aggregate Demand List) that the delay model is based upon. Each ADL contains information on the flights arriving and departing from an airport, or entering into and departing from a flow area.

datatype_properties.label: adsb ID
datatype_properties.comment: The unique identifier of the ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast) transponder unit on board the aircraft for this flight.

datatype_properties.label: advisory number
datatype_properties.comment: Advisory number as reported from the FAA Command Center database. it restarts at 001 on every new day UTC.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft count
datatype_properties.comment: The number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft weight category
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates the weight category as part of a flight specification constraint.

datatype_properties.label: call sign
datatype_properties.comment: The flight identifier (3-letter ICAO code plus number).

datatype_properties.label: cruising altitude
datatype_properties.comment: The cruising altitude (in number of feet) specified in the flight plan for this flight.

datatype_properties.label: delay assignment mode
datatype_properties.comment: The type of delay assignment mode specified for this delay model: DAS, GAAP, or UDP.

datatype_properties.label: effective end time
datatype_properties.comment: The expected end time of the traffic management initiative (TMI).

datatype_properties.label: effective start time
datatype_properties.comment: The expected start time of the traffic management initiative (TMI).

datatype_properties.label: extension probability
datatype_properties.comment: The probability that this traffic management initiative (TMI) will be extended: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

datatype_properties.label: fix ID
datatype_properties.comment: A non-unique FAA identifier for a fix. When combined with a fix ICAO code, it defines a unique fix worldwide. Often, but not always, the fixId is identical to the fixName.

datatype_properties.label: fix name
datatype_properties.comment: A unique FAA identier for a fix that can be filed as part of a flight plan. The fix name conceptually represents the worldwide-unique combination of a FixID and ICAO code. Often, but not always, the fixId is identical to the fixName.

datatype_properties.label: fix trajectory string
datatype_properties.comment: This is an experimental property of a flight that stores an ordered sequence of named fixes corresponding one-to-one to the sequence of trajectory track points recorded for the flight. For a given track point, the corresponding named fix is computed by finding the closest named fix to the track point.

datatype_properties.label: flight plan ETA
datatype_properties.comment: The estimated time of arrival specified in the flight plan.

datatype_properties.label: flight route string
datatype_properties.comment: A string that provides the route of flight proposed in a flight plan. Syntactically, the string shows a path of fixes, airways, SIDs, and STARs, separated by either one or two dots. The string is parsed to create an equivalent ontology representation: an ordered sequence of navigation elements that are associated directly with the flight plan (atm:PlannedFlightRoute).

datatype_properties.label: flow capacity
datatype_properties.comment: The maximum controllable number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time.

datatype_properties.label: ground speed
datatype_properties.comment: The reported ground speed at an aircraft track point.

datatype_properties.label: heading
datatype_properties.comment: The aircraft heading at the track point: a number between 0.01 and 360.0 indicating the angular heading with respect to North.

datatype_properties.label: impacting condition
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates the reason for initiating the Ground Delay Program: weather, volume, runway, equipment, other.

datatype_properties.label: impacting condition message
datatype_properties.comment: A free-text descriptoin elaborating on the reason for initiating the Ground Delay Program.

datatype_properties.label: implementation status
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates the enforcement status of the ReRoute advisory: RQD (required), RMD (recommended), PLN (planned for implementation), FYI (informational only)

datatype_properties.label: includes aircraft class
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates which class of aircraft the flights defined by this specification must employ: jet, prop, jet and prop, turbo, all.

datatype_properties.label: includes airport type
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates which type of airports are included in the set of airports covered by this airport specification: all, US, CONUS, NonCONUS, International, Canadian. This property allows for the implicit specification of an entire class of airports; the property atm:includesAirport allows for the explicit specification of a list of specific airports.
Provides any specific comments on the traffic management initiative (TMI) made by the issuing authority (e.g., ATCSCC, ARTCC).

datatype_properties.label: issued time
datatype_properties.comment: The time when the traffic management initiative (TMI) was issued.

datatype_properties.label: max flow capacity
datatype_properties.comment: The absolute maximum controllable number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time under any air traffic conditions.

datatype_properties.label: modeled average delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The average flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: modeled maximum delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The maximum flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: modeled total delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The total flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: plan filing time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the flight plan was filed with the FAA.

datatype_properties.label: plan gap after sequence element number
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates the location of a gap in the flight plan due to non-parsable/uninterpretable elements in the flight plan string.

datatype_properties.label: planned arrival time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the flight is planned to arrive per the flight plan.

datatype_properties.label: planned departure time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the flight is planned to depart per the flight plan.

datatype_properties.label: previous average delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The average flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: previous maximum delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The maximum flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: previous total delay minutes
datatype_properties.comment: The total flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_properties.label: published arrival time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the flight is planned to arrive per the OAG schedule.

datatype_properties.label: published departure time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the flight is planned to depart per the OAG schedule.

datatype_properties.label: radial angle
datatype_properties.comment: The angle (in degrees) that defines the radial route's angular position with respect to the defined fix.

datatype_properties.label: reroute reason
datatype_properties.comment: Provides the reason for initiating a ReRoute: WEATHER , VOLUME , EQUIPMENT , RUNWAY/TAXIWAY , OTHER.

datatype_properties.label: re route segment type
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates which type of ReRoute segment: origin , destination, origin-destination. A ReRoute segment can be a entire route between origin and destination, or a partial route leading from an origin or leading to a destination.

datatype_properties.label: ReRoute time type
datatype_properties.comment: The time period associated with the reroute is specified in one of three ways. The reroute can apply to flights that: depart specified airports or centers during a certain time window (timeType=ETD); depart specified airports or centers to arrive at their destinations during a certain time window (timeType=ETA); or arrive at the boundary of a flow constrained area during a certain time window (timeType=FCA Flight List).

datatype_properties.label: ReRoute type
datatype_properties.comment: The ReRoute type encodes information about the type of ReRoute being initiated or the reason for the ReRoute. One of the following: ROUTE , PLAYBOOK , CDR, SPECIAL OPERATIONS, NRP SUSPENSIONS, VS , NAT, SHUTTLE ACTIVITY, FCA, FEA, INFORMATIONAL, MISCELLANEOUS.

datatype_properties.label: relative angle
datatype_properties.comment: The angular direction in degrees (1-360) of a relative fix with respect to its defining absolute fix.

datatype_properties.label: relative distance
datatype_properties.comment: The distance (in nautical miles) between a relative fix and its defining (absolute) fix.

datatype_properties.label: reporting time
datatype_properties.comment: The time when an en route aircraft passed through a trackpoint and reported its position, speed, and heading.

datatype_properties.label: time constraint type
datatype_properties.comment: Specifies the type of flight time being constrained in this flight specification: either ETA (estimated arrival time) or ETD (estimated departure time).

datatype_properties.label: tracon ID
datatype_properties.comment: Three letter FAA TRACON identifier code.

datatype_properties.label: true airspeed
datatype_properties.comment: The true airspeed of a flight: the speed of the aircraft relative to the airmass in which it is flying.

datatype_properties.label: user category
datatype_properties.comment: The type of airspace user that this flight represents: GA, Air Taxi, Cargo, Commercial, Military. Also used to constrain a flight specification to contain only flights representing a specific user category.

datatype_properties.label: air carrier alias
datatype_properties.comment: An alternative name for an air carrier.

datatype_properties.label: Air carrier name
datatype_properties.comment: The official name of an air carrier.

datatype_properties.label: airline callsign
datatype_properties.comment: The radio call sign associated with an the air carrier. Used by pilots and controllers to identify aircraft over radio frequencies.

datatype_properties.label: airport name
datatype_properties.comment: The official name of the airport.

datatype_properties.label: airspace layer high altitude
datatype_properties.comment: The upper altitude bound of an airspace layer.

datatype_properties.label: airspace layer low altitude
datatype_properties.comment: The lower altitude bound of an airspace layer.

datatype_properties.label: artcc ID
datatype_properties.comment: The 3-letter ARTCC (Air Route Traffic Control Center) code.

datatype_properties.label: country of registry
datatype_properties.comment: The country name of the airline registration.

datatype_properties.label: FAA airport code
datatype_properties.comment: The alphanumeric FAA code of lenth 3 or 4 for the airport. Contrasted with the ICAO and IATA codes, which in general are different. Often the IATA and FAA codes are identical.

datatype_properties.label: gate ID
datatype_properties.comment: The gate identifier assigned by the airport authority.

datatype_properties.label: has sector ID
datatype_properties.comment: A sector identifier that consists of the ARTCC identifier concatenated with a three-digit number. This identifier is in general different than the sector name.

datatype_properties.label: has sector name
datatype_properties.comment: An alphanumeric sector name that is in general different than the sector ID.

datatype_properties.label: has TRACONcity
datatype_properties.comment: The city name where the TRACON command center is located.

datatype_properties.label: has TRACON ID
datatype_properties.comment: The FAA alphanumeric code for the TRACON.

datatype_properties.label: has TRACON name
datatype_properties.comment: The common name for the TRACON.

datatype_properties.label: has TRACONstate
datatype_properties.comment: The name of the US state in which the TRACON command center is located.

datatype_properties.label: has TRACONtype
datatype_properties.comment: The type of TRACON: Tower-colocated TRACON or standalone TRACON.

datatype_properties.label: hours offset from UTC
datatype_properties.comment: The number of hours that the airport is offset from the UTC timezone.

datatype_properties.label: IATA Airport Code
datatype_properties.comment: The thre-letter IATA code assigned to the airport. Contrast with the ICAO and FAA airport codes.

datatype_properties.label: IATA Carrier Code
datatype_properties.comment: The two-letter IATA code assigned to the carrier.

datatype_properties.label: ICAO airport code
datatype_properties.comment: The four-letter ICAO code assignied to the airport. Contrast with the IATA and FAA airport codes.

datatype_properties.label: ICAO Air Carrier Code
datatype_properties.comment: The three-letter ICAO code assigned to the airline carrier.

datatype_properties.label: is instrument control eligible
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates whether this airport is capable of an instrument approach.

datatype_properties.label: is weather reporting station
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates whether this airport is a METAR weather reporting station.

datatype_properties.label: Located in State
datatype_properties.comment: The 2-letter US postal code for the state in which the airport is located.

datatype_properties.label: manufacturer full name
datatype_properties.comment: The full name of the manufacturer.

datatype_properties.label: max visibility
datatype_properties.comment: The upper bound of visibility in feet over the centerline of the runway.

datatype_properties.label: min visibility
datatype_properties.comment: The lower bound of visibility in feet over the centerline of the runway.

datatype_properties.label: route ID
datatype_properties.comment: FAA alphanumeric identifier assigned to the route/airway.

datatype_properties.label: runway ID
datatype_properties.comment: An identifier for the runway. For physical runways, the convention is to label runways by their heading, dropping the last digit. E.g. for Liverpool, runway 9/27 is facing approximately magnetic heading 90 degrees in one direction, and 270 degrees in the opposite direction. If an airport has parallel runways, these would then be marked Left, Center and Right, e.g. 9L, 9C, 9R. For operational runways, the runway identifiers specifies one direction only: either 9 or 27 in the Liverpool example.

datatype_properties.label: runway length in feet
datatype_properties.comment: The length in feet of the physical runway.

datatype_properties.label: runway width in feet
datatype_properties.comment: The width in feet of the physical runway.

datatype_properties.label: sidstar ID
datatype_properties.comment: The FAA identifier for the SID or STAR. Typically, but not uniformly, 5 alpha characters plus a revision digit.

datatype_properties.label: taxiway ID
datatype_properties.comment: An identifier for the taxiway.

datatype_properties.label: terminal ID
datatype_properties.comment: The alphanumeric identifier of the airport terminal.

datatype_properties.label: tfms monitor alert parameter
datatype_properties.comment: The maximum number of aircraft permitted in a given sector at any time, per agreement between FAA and Air Traffic Controller union. MAP (Monitor Alert Parameter) is a TFMS input parameter.

datatype_properties.label: tier level
datatype_properties.comment: The degree number of the ARTCC tier. Tier 1 includes the central ARTCC plus all ARTCCs immediately adjoining the central ARTCC; tier 2 includes tier 1 plus all adjacent ARTCCs two steps away from the central ARTCC. And so on.

datatype_properties.label: tower ID
datatype_properties.comment: The FAA identifier for air traffic control tower.

datatype_properties.label: within timezone
datatype_properties.comment: The timezone identifier for the airport, where the timezone is specified as Area/Location, e.g. America/New_York.

datatype_properties.label: airport arrival rate
datatype_properties.comment: The arrival rate per hour set by the airport during the specified interval. This is the total number of aircraft that can arrive on all runways combined during an hour.

datatype_properties.label: airport departure rate
datatype_properties.comment: The departure rate per hour set by the airport during the specified interval. This is the total number of aircraft that can depart from all runways combined during an hour.

datatype_properties.label: arrival demand
datatype_properties.comment: The number of aircraft intending to arrive at an airport during the specified time period.

datatype_properties.label: ASPM Flight Rules
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates what flight rule conditions the airport is operating under during the specified time period (I-instrument, V-Visual).

datatype_properties.label: base altitude
datatype_properties.comment: For a given homogeonous cloud layer, this is the lowest altitude.

datatype_properties.label: ceiling
datatype_properties.comment: The vertical visibility (in feet) measured from the ground to the lowest cloud layer reported as broken or overcast.

datatype_properties.label: cloud cover
datatype_properties.comment: For a given homogenous cloud layer, the type of cloud cover present: clear, few clouds, scattered clouds, broken clouds, overcast, vertical visibility layer.

datatype_properties.label: cloud type
datatype_properties.comment: For a given homogeneous cloud layer, the type of cloud present: towering cumulus, cumulonimbus, altocumulus castellanus.

datatype_properties.label: data interval end time
datatype_properties.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the ending time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_properties.label: data interval start time
datatype_properties.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the starting time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_properties.label: departure demand
datatype_properties.comment: The number of aircraft intending to depart during the specified time period.

datatype_properties.label: dewpoint temperature
datatype_properties.comment: The dewpoint temperature in degrees. It is the temperature at which the air can no longer hold all of its water vapor, and some of the water vapor must condense into liquid water. The dew point is always lower than (or equal to) the air temperature.

datatype_properties.label: EDCT arrival hold
datatype_properties.comment: EDCT (Estimated Departure Clearance Time) hold minutes at other airports arriving this airport.

datatype_properties.label: EDCT departure hold
datatype_properties.comment: EDCT (Estimated Departure Clearance Time) hold minutes at other airports departing this airport.

datatype_properties.label: etms arrivals
datatype_properties.comment: Count of arrivals at airport based on ETMS (Enhanced Traffic Management System) data.

datatype_properties.label: etms arrivals
datatype_properties.comment: Count of departures at airport based on ETMS (Enhanced Traffic Management System) data.

datatype_properties.label: forecast issue time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the report was issued.

datatype_properties.label: high wind WITI daily
datatype_properties.comment: The high wind weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the winds at the airport are above a set threshold, then the high wind WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: high wind WITI hourly
datatype_properties.comment: The high wind weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the winds at the airport are above a set threshold, then the high wind WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: hourly precipitation
datatype_properties.comment: Recorded hourly precipitation rate at the measurement station in inches.

datatype_properties.label: limited visibility distance
datatype_properties.comment: The visibility distance (in miles) at the reporting station. Only applicable if data:unlimitedVisibility is False.

datatype_properties.label: low ceiling WITI daily
datatype_properties.comment: The low ceiling weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the ceiling at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low ceiling WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: low ceiling WITI hourly
datatype_properties.comment: The low ceiling weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the ceiling at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low ceiling WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: low visibility WITI daily
datatype_properties.comment: The low visibility weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the visibility at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low visibility WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: low visibility WITI hourly
datatype_properties.comment: The low visibility weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the visibility at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low visibility WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_properties.label: met condition probability
datatype_properties.comment: For a forecast meteorological condition, the percent probability associated with the forecast occurrence.

datatype_properties.label: metar report modifier
datatype_properties.comment: Automation status information pertaining to a METAR report: AUTO indicates a fully automated report with no human intervention; COR indicates a corrected observation; no modifier indicates either human observer/reporter or automated report with human oversight.

datatype_properties.label: METAR report string
datatype_properties.comment: Entire text of METAR report.

datatype_properties.label: metar report type
datatype_properties.comment: METAR report type indicator specifies whether this report is a regularly scheduled hourly report (METAR) or a special unscheduled report (SPECI). SPECIs are issued more frequently than hourly when adverse weather conditions prevail.

datatype_properties.label: metar station has precipitation sensor
datatype_properties.comment: A boolean value indicating whether the reporting METAR station has a precipitation sensor.

datatype_properties.label: meteorological condition status
datatype_properties.comment: An indicator of whether the meteorological condition is based on actual observations (observed) or on future projections (forecast).

datatype_properties.label: OAG arrival delay
datatype_properties.comment: Minutes of OAG (Official Airline Guide) based arrival delay in excess of 15 minutes.

datatype_properties.label: OAG gate departure delay
datatype_properties.comment: Minutes of OAG (Official Airline Guide) based gate departure delay in excess of 15 minutes.

datatype_properties.label: rapidity of weather change
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates how fast change is expected from the prior state to the forecast meteorological conditions: "rapid" , "gradual" , "transient".

datatype_properties.label: runway status
datatype_properties.comment: An indicator of whether the runway is open or closed during the specified period.

datatype_properties.label: runway surface friction (mu)
datatype_properties.comment: The surface friction (mu) value of the runway for the specified period. Runway surface friction is directly relevant to the braking action which will be available to an aircraft decelerating after touch down, or after a decision to reject a take off.

datatype_properties.label: scheduled arrivals
datatype_properties.comment: Count of scheduled arrivals. (Most probably from OAG (Official Airline Guide))

datatype_properties.label: scheduled departures
datatype_properties.comment: Count of scheduled departures. (Most probably from OAG (Official Airline Guide))

datatype_properties.label: sea level pressure
datatype_properties.comment: Sea level pressure measured under the associated meteorological conditions.

datatype_properties.label: surface gust speed
datatype_properties.comment: Surface gust speed measured under the associated surface wind conditions.

datatype_properties.label: surface temperature
datatype_properties.comment: Surface temperature measured under the associated meteorological conditions.

datatype_properties.label: surface wind direction status
datatype_properties.comment: Information about the direction of the wind, either fixed, varyingWithinRange, or variable.

datatype_properties.label: surface wind speed
datatype_properties.comment: The speed in knots of the surface wind.

datatype_properties.label: taf report string
datatype_properties.comment: The full text of the entire Meteorological report.

datatype_properties.label: taf report type
datatype_properties.comment: Type of Terminal Area Forecast (TAF) report: a routine report (TAF), an amended report (AMD), a corrected report (COR), or a delayed report (RTD). An amended TAF is issued when the current TAF no longer adequately describes the ongoing weather or the forecaster feels the TAF is not representative of the current or expected weather.

datatype_properties.label: top altitude
datatype_properties.comment: The top altitude of a homogenous cloud layer.

datatype_properties.label: total airborne delay
datatype_properties.comment: Total airborne flight delay in minutes for this airport during the specified period.

datatype_properties.label: unlimited visibility
datatype_properties.comment: A binary property indicating whether the visibility conditions are unlimited.

datatype_properties.label: weather intensity
datatype_properties.comment: An indicator of the intensity of the weather: light, moderate, heavy.

datatype_properties.label: weather phenomenon
datatype_properties.comment: Describes the type of weather phenomena experienced during the specified period: drizzle, rain, snow, snow grains, ice crystals, ice pellets, hail, small hail and/or snow pellets, unknown precipitation, mist, fog, smoke, volcanic ash, widespread dust, sand, haze, spray, well-developed dust/sand whirls, squalls, funnel cloud, tornado/waterspout, sandstorm, duststorm

datatype_properties.label: weather proximity
datatype_properties.comment: Describes the location of the weather phenomena in relation to the reporting station: immediate proximity or in vicinity.

datatype_properties.label: weather qualifier
datatype_properties.comment: An additional qualifier describing the reported weather phenomenon: shallow, partial, patchy, low drifting, blowing, shower, thunderstorm, freezing.

datatype_properties.label: fixed wind direction
datatype_properties.comment: Steady wind direction (in degrees), when winds are fixed and not variable.

datatype_properties.label: lower wind direction
datatype_properties.comment: Lower bound (in degrees) of two bounding values describing a variable wind direction.

datatype_properties.label: lower wind direction
datatype_properties.comment: Upper bound (in degrees) of two bounding values describing a variable wind direction.

datatype_properties.label: wind shear height
datatype_properties.comment: The height in hundreds of feet above ground level associated with a wind shear phenomenon.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft model certainty
datatype_properties.comment: A numeric measure between 0 and 1 reflecting how certain the eqp:hasAircraftModel link is to be correct between the aircraft and the model. A value of one indicates 100% certainty. A lesser value is not to be taken as a percentage, but is a heuristic similarity value taken from the scoring of the TF/IDF similarity assessment performed between the FAA aircraft make/model in the FAA registration database and ICAO make/model names used in the ontology.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft registrant
datatype_properties.comment: The name of the entity that registered the aircraft with the FAA.

datatype_properties.label: serial number
datatype_properties.comment: The manufacturer serial number of the aircraft.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft type designator
datatype_properties.comment: The type designator code for this type of aircraft (e.g., B777).

datatype_properties.label: aircraft weight high bound
datatype_properties.comment: The upper bound of the aircraft weight category.

datatype_properties.label: aircraft weight low bound
datatype_properties.comment: The lower bound of the aircraft weight category.

datatype_properties.label: certificate issue date
datatype_properties.comment: The date that an operating certificate was issued to the aircraft.

datatype_properties.label: CICTT number
datatype_properties.comment: CAST/ICAO Common Taxonomy Team (CICTT) identifier for this model as specified by the International Aircraft Categorisation And Identification Standard (IACIS).

datatype_properties.label: engine type description
datatype_properties.comment: A text description of the engine type characteristics.

datatype_properties.label: manufacture year
datatype_properties.comment: The year the system was manufactured.

datatype_properties.label: max takeoff weight high bound
datatype_properties.comment: The upper bound of the maximum takeoff weight for this category.

datatype_properties.label: max takeoff weight low bound
datatype_properties.comment: The lower bound of the maximum takeoff weight for this category.

datatype_properties.label: mode SCode
datatype_properties.comment: The unique Mode S address of the transponder aboard the aircraft. Mode S equipment on aircraft are assigned a unique ICAO 24-bit address or (informally) Mode S hex code upon national registration and this address becomes a part of the aircraft's Certificate of Registration.

datatype_properties.label: model ID
datatype_properties.comment: The string identifier of the model for this system/subsystem/assembly.

datatype_properties.label: number of engines
datatype_properties.comment: The number of engines specified for this aircraft model or found on this aircraft.

datatype_properties.label: number of seats
datatype_properties.comment: The number of seats on this aircraft.

datatype_properties.label: registration number
datatype_properties.comment: The aircraft FAA registration number (the tail number, or the N-Number in the US).

datatype_properties.label: wake category ID
datatype_properties.comment: The wake category identification character (A through F).

datatype_properties.label: wing span high bound
datatype_properties.comment: The upper bound of the wingspan for this category.

datatype_properties.label: wing span low bound
datatype_properties.comment: The lower bound of the wingspan for this category.

datatype_properties.label: Well-Known Text geographic representation
datatype_properties.comment: The WKT string representation of a location. Well-known text (WKT) is a text markup language for representing vector geometry objects on a map, spatial reference systems of spatial objects and transformations between spatial reference systems. WKT is a standards-based representation stored as an alternative to the explicit polygon boundary representation employed in the Ontology (see gen:PolygonBoundary).

datatype_properties.label: altitude
datatype_properties.comment: The altitude of a point location.

datatype_properties.label: latitude
datatype_properties.comment: The latitude of a point location.

datatype_properties.label: longitude
datatype_properties.comment: The longitude of a point location.

datatype_properties.label: polygon height
datatype_properties.comment: Specifies the length dimension of a polygonal volume.

datatype_properties.label: radius
datatype_properties.comment: The radius of a circular region. Note: Unfortunately, the units are currently dependent the type of circular region defined. This needs to be improved.

datatype_properties.label: sequence length
datatype_properties.comment: The number of items in the ordered sequence.

datatype_properties.label: sequenceNumber
datatype_properties.comment: Indicates the ordered position of this item within the sequence, where 1 signifies the first position in the sequence.

object_property_signatures.label: aircraft fix
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft track point with its associated navigation fix.

object_property_signatures.label: aircraft flown
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight with the actual aircraft used.

object_property_signatures.label: aircraft type flown
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight with the type of aircraft flown. The aircraft 'type' corresponds to a set of aircraft models with similar characteristics.

object_property_signatures.label: allowed route
object_property_signatures.comment: In a reRoute traffic management initiative, there are multiple allowed routes specified between origin and destination. This property links a ReRouteTMI with its allowed routes.

object_property_signatures.label: alternate arrival airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the alternate arrival airport to be used in case of weather, traffic, or other unforseen contingency. The alternate airport is specified in the flight plan.

object_property_signatures.label: arrival airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the actual arrival airport for the flight.

object_property_signatures.label: arrival runway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the actual arrival runway for the flight.

object_property_signatures.label: arrival taxi path
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the taxipath followed by the flight en route to the gate.

object_property_signatures.label: controlled NASelement
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a traffic management initiative (TMI) to the airspace element being controlled by the TMI (e.g., an airport).

object_property_signatures.label: departure airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the actual departure airport for the flight.

object_property_signatures.label: departure runway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the actual departure runway for the flight.

object_property_signatures.label: departure scope
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the departure airport(s) participating in the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_property_signatures.label: departure taxi path
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the taxipath followed by the flight en route to the runway.

object_property_signatures.label: excludes ARTCC
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more ARTCCs (Centers) or ARTCC tiers (Centers radiating out from a give ARTCC). Any airport within the ARTCC or ARTCC tier is excluded from the set of airports covered by this airport specification.

object_property_signatures.label: excludes airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more airports. Any airport linked is excluded from the set of airports covered by this airport specification.

object_property_signatures.label: excludes airway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more airways (routes). Any flight that traverses a linked airway is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: excludes fix
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more navigation fixes. Any flight that traverses a linked fix is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: excludes flight
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more flights. Any linked flight is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: exempted AFP
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more Airspace Flow Program (AFP) traffic management initiatives (TMIs). Any flight included in one of the linked AFPs is excluded from the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: flight exclusion spec
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the flight(s) excluded from the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_property_signatures.label: flight inclusion exclusion
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a ReRoute to a specification of the flight(s) included in or excluded from the ReRoute traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_property_signatures.label: flight inclusion spec
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a specification of the flight(s) included in the traffic management initiative (TMI).

object_property_signatures.label: flow measurement region
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft capacity or aircraft flow to the spatial region through which flow or capacity is being monitored and measured.

object_property_signatures.label: has actual route
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight to its actual trajectory (i.e., a sequence of track points), as determined by flight track surveillance data.

object_property_signatures.label: has crew member
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight to its crew members.

object_property_signatures.label: has navigation element
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a container for a navigational element to the element contained.

object_property_signatures.label: has planned route
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight to a version of its flight plan. (Which version gets stored is application-dependent.) There are multiple versions of the flight plan generated and then amended during the course of the flight, starting in the pre-flight timeframe and extending through to the termination of the flight.

object_property_signatures.label: included flights
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft flow to a specification of the flights included in the flow.

object_property_signatures.label: includes airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport specification to one of more airports. Any airport linked is included in the set of airports covered by this airport specification. This property allows for explicit specification of a list of specific airports; the property atm:includesAirportType allows for the the implicit specification of an entire class of airports.

object_property_signatures.label: includes airway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more airways (routes). Any flight that traverses a linked airway is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: includes fix
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more navigation fixes. Any flight that traverses a linked fix is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: includes flight
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one of more flights. Any linked flight is included in the set of flights covered by this flight specification.

object_property_signatures.label: located in sector
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a navigation fix to the airspace sector in which that fix is located.

object_property_signatures.label: modeled arrival rate
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a delay model used in defining a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS) to a sequence of desired hourly aircraft arrival rates specified for the initiative.

object_property_signatures.label: modeled by
