object_property_signatures.comment: Links a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or a Ground Stop (GS) to a representation of the model used to design that initiative. The model contains all relevant parameters used to create the initiative.

object_property_signatures.label: modeled pop up factor
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a delay model used in defining a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS) to a sequence of desired hourly popup factors specified for the initiative. 'Popups' account for late-filing flights (unexpected/unplanned flights) when modeling delays as part of a traffic management initiative (TMI) design process.

object_property_signatures.label: must have destination
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to an airport specification describing the destination airports for the flights being specified. Any flight covered by the flight specification must have as its destination one of the airports covered by the airport specification.

object_property_signatures.label: must have origin
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to an airport specification describing the originating airports for the flights being specified. Any flight covered by the flight specification must have as its origin one of the airports covered by the airport specification.

object_property_signatures.label: operated by
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight to its carrier airline.

object_property_signatures.label: operating carrier
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a flight specification to one or more carrier airline(s). Each flight covered by the specification must be operated by one of these carriers.

object_property_signatures.label: radial fix
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the fix through which the radial route passes.

object_property_signatures.label: reroute constraint
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a route segment specified as part of a ReRoute traffic management initiative (TMI) to a flight specification indicating which flights are permitted to follow the route segment.

object_property_signatures.label: re route path
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a route segment alternative (specified as part of a ReRoute traffic management initiative) to its associated flight plan.

Links a relative fix to the absolute fix that serves as the basis for its location. (A relative fix position is defined relative to an absolute fix position, e.g. as a vector offset from the absolute fix.)

object_property_signatures.label: traverses SIDSTAR
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (i.e., a specific route through a SID or STAR) to the specific SID or STAR being traversed by a given flight.

object_property_signatures.label: uses airport route
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (a path through a SID/STAR) to the airport route used in making the traverse.

object_property_signatures.label: uses transition route
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a SIDSTARtraverse (a path through a SID/STAR) to the transition route used in making the traverse.

object_property_signatures.label: within ARTCC
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport specification to an ARTCC or ARTCC tier. Only airports within the ARTCC or ARTCC tier are covered by the specification.

object_property_signatures.label: within airport bounding region
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport specification to a circular geographic region. Only airports whose locations fall within this region satisfy the specification.

object_property_signatures.label: adjacent sector
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a sector to an immediately adjacent sector that shares a boundary.

object_property_signatures.label: airport boundary
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to a representation of its perimeter boundary.

object_property_signatures.label: airport location
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to a geographic point designated as the airport location.

object_property_signatures.label: arrival route airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the airport for which this route is destined.

object_property_signatures.label: associated airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates some component of airport infrastructure (runway, terminal, tower, etc.) with its airport.

object_property_signatures.label: associated operational runway
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a physical runway with its two operational runways (180 degrees apart, representing approaches from either end of the physical runway).

object_property_signatures.label: deicing pad location
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a deicing pad with its location as a two-dimensional bounding polygon.

object_property_signatures.label: departure route airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the airport from which this route is destined.

object_property_signatures.label: has airport route
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_property_signatures.label: has airspace layer geometry
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airspace layer with a polygon describing its location in 3-space. A sector is composed of a sequence of layers, each of which is represented as a shear-sided polygonal volume.

object_property_signatures.label: has center geometry
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an ARTCC to a 2-dimensional bounding polygon.

object_property_signatures.label: has common route
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a common route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_property_signatures.label: has gate
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport terminal with a aircraft gate located at that terminal.

object_property_signatures.label: has LOA with
object_property_signatures.comment: This property links a NAS facility to another NAS facility when there is a letter of agreement (LOA) in place between them.

object_property_signatures.label: has queue
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a deicing pad to its queue of aircraft waiting to be deiced.

object_property_signatures.label: has ramp tower
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport terminal with a ramp tower that controlls the aircraft and vehicle traffic in the vicinity of that terminal.

object_property_signatures.label: has runway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to a physical runway for that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has SID
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport with the the SIDs designated to route aircraft from that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has STAR
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport with the the STARs designated to route aircraft to that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has sector layer
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a sector to its vertically-stacked set of layers.

object_property_signatures.label: has TRACON layer
object_property_signatures.comment: A link between the TRACON and its geographic extent, represented as a single shear-sided polygonal volume.

object_property_signatures.label: has taxiway
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to a taxiway for that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has terminal
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to a terminal for that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has tier
object_property_signatures.comment: Asociates an ARTCC with the set of ARTCCs in its nth level tier. Tier 1 includes the central ARTCC plus all ARTCCs immediately adjoining the central ARTCC; tier 2 includes tier 1 plus all adjacent ARTCCs two steps away from the central ARTCC. And so on.

object_property_signatures.label: has tower
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to an air traffic control tower for that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has transition route
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a transition route with a SID or STAR. A SID or STAR has a single common route, but can have multiple airport or transition routes.

object_property_signatures.label: includes ARTCC
object_property_signatures.comment: A link between an ARTCC tier and the ARTCCs included in the tier.

object_property_signatures.label: located in Center
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a sector to the ARTCC in which the sector is located.

object_property_signatures.label: runway footprint
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a physical runway with its bounding two-dimensional rectangle.

object_property_signatures.label: runway measured
object_property_signatures.comment: Indicates which operational runway is being measured for visible range.

object_property_signatures.label: taxiway location
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a taxiway with its bounding two-dimensional rectangle.

object_property_signatures.label: touchdown point
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the geographical point location that is the touchdown spot on the operational runway.

object_property_signatures.label: within ARTCC
object_property_signatures.comment: Links the airport to the ARTCC within which it is located.

object_property_signatures.label: forecasting airport
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the airport for which the report was compiled.

object_property_signatures.label: has airport data
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an airport to a collection of temporally-dependent data pertinent to the airport conditions, including a variety of data collected in the ASPM system.

object_property_signatures.label: has cloud layer profile
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a sky condition to a representation of the cloud layers present.

object_property_signatures.label: has meteorological condition
object_property_signatures.comment: Links meteorological information to the collection of temporally-dependent data associated with an airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has Meteorological report
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates an airport with weather reports generated for that airport.

object_property_signatures.label: has sky condition
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the sky and cloud conditions at the reporting location..

object_property_signatures.label: has surface wind condition
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the surface wind conditions at the reporting location..

object_property_signatures.label: has visibility condition
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the surface visibility conditions at the reporting location..

object_property_signatures.label: has weather condition
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a meteorological condition with the details of the weather conditions at the reporting location.

object_property_signatures.label: runway reported on
object_property_signatures.comment: Associates a runway status report with the physical runway being measured.

object_property_signatures.label: runway visible range
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a visibility condition to a runway visible range measurement class instance.

object_property_signatures.label: designed by
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft model to the airframe manufacturer that designed the model.

object_property_signatures.label: has aircraft engine type
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft type to the type of engine it uses.

object_property_signatures.label: has aircraft model
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a specific aircraft to its model.

object_property_signatures.label: has aircraft wake category
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft model to its wake category.

object_property_signatures.label: has aircraft weight class
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft model to its weight class.

object_property_signatures.label: has component
object_property_signatures.comment: Connects an engineered system to its primitive components.

object_property_signatures.label: has subsystem
object_property_signatures.comment: Connects an engineered system to its subsystems.

object_property_signatures.label: is aircraft type
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an aircraft model to its type, where the type represents a set of related models.

object_property_signatures.label: manufactured by
object_property_signatures.comment: A link to the entity that manufactured the system.

object_property_signatures.label: centerpoint
object_property_signatures.comment: Links to the center point of the 2-D circular region.

object_property_signatures.label: hasNext
object_property_signatures.comment: Links an item in a sequence to the subsequent item in the sequence.

object_property_signatures.label: has polygon boundary
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a polygonal region to its boundary representation.

object_property_signatures.label: hasSequencedItem
object_property_signatures.comment: Links a sequence to each of the items being sequenced.

datatype_property_signatures.label: actual arrival time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time determined by surveillance data sources to be the 'actual' time of flight arrival, versus the scheduled time or the time specified in the flight plan, etc.

datatype_property_signatures.label: actual departure time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time determined by surveillance data sources to be the 'actual' time of flight departure, versus the scheduled time or the time specified in the flight plan, etc.

datatype_property_signatures.label: adl time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The timestamp of the ADL (Aggregate Demand List) that the delay model is based upon. Each ADL contains information on the flights arriving and departing from an airport, or entering into and departing from a flow area.

datatype_property_signatures.label: adsb ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The unique identifier of the ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast) transponder unit on board the aircraft for this flight.

datatype_property_signatures.label: advisory number
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Advisory number as reported from the FAA Command Center database. it restarts at 001 on every new day UTC.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft count
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft weight category
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates the weight category as part of a flight specification constraint.

datatype_property_signatures.label: call sign
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The flight identifier (3-letter ICAO code plus number).

datatype_property_signatures.label: cruising altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The cruising altitude (in number of feet) specified in the flight plan for this flight.

datatype_property_signatures.label: delay assignment mode
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The type of delay assignment mode specified for this delay model: DAS, GAAP, or UDP.

datatype_property_signatures.label: effective end time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The expected end time of the traffic management initiative (TMI).

datatype_property_signatures.label: effective start time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The expected start time of the traffic management initiative (TMI).

datatype_property_signatures.label: extension probability
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The probability that this traffic management initiative (TMI) will be extended: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

datatype_property_signatures.label: fix ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A non-unique FAA identifier for a fix. When combined with a fix ICAO code, it defines a unique fix worldwide. Often, but not always, the fixId is identical to the fixName.

datatype_property_signatures.label: fix name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A unique FAA identier for a fix that can be filed as part of a flight plan. The fix name conceptually represents the worldwide-unique combination of a FixID and ICAO code. Often, but not always, the fixId is identical to the fixName.

datatype_property_signatures.label: fix trajectory string
datatype_property_signatures.comment: This is an experimental property of a flight that stores an ordered sequence of named fixes corresponding one-to-one to the sequence of trajectory track points recorded for the flight. For a given track point, the corresponding named fix is computed by finding the closest named fix to the track point.

datatype_property_signatures.label: flight plan ETA
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The estimated time of arrival specified in the flight plan.

datatype_property_signatures.label: flight route string
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A string that provides the route of flight proposed in a flight plan. Syntactically, the string shows a path of fixes, airways, SIDs, and STARs, separated by either one or two dots. The string is parsed to create an equivalent ontology representation: an ordered sequence of navigation elements that are associated directly with the flight plan (atm:PlannedFlightRoute).

datatype_property_signatures.label: flow capacity
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The maximum controllable number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ground speed
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The reported ground speed at an aircraft track point.

datatype_property_signatures.label: heading
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The aircraft heading at the track point: a number between 0.01 and 360.0 indicating the angular heading with respect to North.

datatype_property_signatures.label: impacting condition
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates the reason for initiating the Ground Delay Program: weather, volume, runway, equipment, other.

datatype_property_signatures.label: impacting condition message
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A free-text descriptoin elaborating on the reason for initiating the Ground Delay Program.

datatype_property_signatures.label: implementation status
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates the enforcement status of the ReRoute advisory: RQD (required), RMD (recommended), PLN (planned for implementation), FYI (informational only)

datatype_property_signatures.label: includes aircraft class
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates which class of aircraft the flights defined by this specification must employ: jet, prop, jet and prop, turbo, all.

datatype_property_signatures.label: includes airport type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates which type of airports are included in the set of airports covered by this airport specification: all, US, CONUS, NonCONUS, International, Canadian. This property allows for the implicit specification of an entire class of airports; the property atm:includesAirport allows for the explicit specification of a list of specific airports.
Provides any specific comments on the traffic management initiative (TMI) made by the issuing authority (e.g., ATCSCC, ARTCC).

datatype_property_signatures.label: issued time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time when the traffic management initiative (TMI) was issued.

datatype_property_signatures.label: max flow capacity
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The absolute maximum controllable number of aircraft flowing through an airspace region per some interval of time under any air traffic conditions.

datatype_property_signatures.label: modeled average delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The average flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: modeled maximum delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The maximum flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: modeled total delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The total flight delay specified when modeling a Ground Delay Program (GDP) or Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: plan filing time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the flight plan was filed with the FAA.

datatype_property_signatures.label: plan gap after sequence element number
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates the location of a gap in the flight plan due to non-parsable/uninterpretable elements in the flight plan string.

datatype_property_signatures.label: planned arrival time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the flight is planned to arrive per the flight plan.

datatype_property_signatures.label: planned departure time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the flight is planned to depart per the flight plan.

datatype_property_signatures.label: previous average delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The average flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: previous maximum delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The maximum flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: previous total delay minutes
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The total flight delay experienced prior to the start of a Ground Stop(GS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: published arrival time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the flight is planned to arrive per the OAG schedule.

datatype_property_signatures.label: published departure time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the flight is planned to depart per the OAG schedule.

datatype_property_signatures.label: radial angle
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The angle (in degrees) that defines the radial route's angular position with respect to the defined fix.

datatype_property_signatures.label: reroute reason
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Provides the reason for initiating a ReRoute: WEATHER , VOLUME , EQUIPMENT , RUNWAY/TAXIWAY , OTHER.

datatype_property_signatures.label: re route segment type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates which type of ReRoute segment: origin , destination, origin-destination. A ReRoute segment can be a entire route between origin and destination, or a partial route leading from an origin or leading to a destination.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ReRoute time type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time period associated with the reroute is specified in one of three ways. The reroute can apply to flights that: depart specified airports or centers during a certain time window (timeType=ETD); depart specified airports or centers to arrive at their destinations during a certain time window (timeType=ETA); or arrive at the boundary of a flow constrained area during a certain time window (timeType=FCA Flight List).

datatype_property_signatures.label: ReRoute type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The ReRoute type encodes information about the type of ReRoute being initiated or the reason for the ReRoute. One of the following: ROUTE , PLAYBOOK , CDR, SPECIAL OPERATIONS, NRP SUSPENSIONS, VS , NAT, SHUTTLE ACTIVITY, FCA, FEA, INFORMATIONAL, MISCELLANEOUS.

datatype_property_signatures.label: relative angle
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The angular direction in degrees (1-360) of a relative fix with respect to its defining absolute fix.

datatype_property_signatures.label: relative distance
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The distance (in nautical miles) between a relative fix and its defining (absolute) fix.

datatype_property_signatures.label: reporting time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time when an en route aircraft passed through a trackpoint and reported its position, speed, and heading.

datatype_property_signatures.label: time constraint type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Specifies the type of flight time being constrained in this flight specification: either ETA (estimated arrival time) or ETD (estimated departure time).

datatype_property_signatures.label: tracon ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Three letter FAA TRACON identifier code.

datatype_property_signatures.label: true airspeed
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The true airspeed of a flight: the speed of the aircraft relative to the airmass in which it is flying.

datatype_property_signatures.label: user category
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The type of airspace user that this flight represents: GA, Air Taxi, Cargo, Commercial, Military. Also used to constrain a flight specification to contain only flights representing a specific user category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: air carrier alias
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An alternative name for an air carrier.

datatype_property_signatures.label: Air carrier name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The official name of an air carrier.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airline callsign
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The radio call sign associated with an the air carrier. Used by pilots and controllers to identify aircraft over radio frequencies.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airport name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The official name of the airport.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airspace layer high altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The upper altitude bound of an airspace layer.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airspace layer low altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The lower altitude bound of an airspace layer.

datatype_property_signatures.label: artcc ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The 3-letter ARTCC (Air Route Traffic Control Center) code.

datatype_property_signatures.label: country of registry
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The country name of the airline registration.

datatype_property_signatures.label: FAA airport code
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The alphanumeric FAA code of lenth 3 or 4 for the airport. Contrasted with the ICAO and IATA codes, which in general are different. Often the IATA and FAA codes are identical.

datatype_property_signatures.label: gate ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The gate identifier assigned by the airport authority.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has sector ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A sector identifier that consists of the ARTCC identifier concatenated with a three-digit number. This identifier is in general different than the sector name.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has sector name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An alphanumeric sector name that is in general different than the sector ID.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has TRACONcity
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The city name where the TRACON command center is located.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has TRACON ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The FAA alphanumeric code for the TRACON.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has TRACON name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The common name for the TRACON.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has TRACONstate
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The name of the US state in which the TRACON command center is located.

datatype_property_signatures.label: has TRACONtype
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The type of TRACON: Tower-colocated TRACON or standalone TRACON.

datatype_property_signatures.label: hours offset from UTC
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of hours that the airport is offset from the UTC timezone.

datatype_property_signatures.label: IATA Airport Code
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The thre-letter IATA code assigned to the airport. Contrast with the ICAO and FAA airport codes.

datatype_property_signatures.label: IATA Carrier Code
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The two-letter IATA code assigned to the carrier.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ICAO airport code
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The four-letter ICAO code assignied to the airport. Contrast with the IATA and FAA airport codes.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ICAO Air Carrier Code
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The three-letter ICAO code assigned to the airline carrier.

datatype_property_signatures.label: is instrument control eligible
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates whether this airport is capable of an instrument approach.

datatype_property_signatures.label: is weather reporting station
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates whether this airport is a METAR weather reporting station.

datatype_property_signatures.label: Located in State
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The 2-letter US postal code for the state in which the airport is located.

datatype_property_signatures.label: manufacturer full name
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The full name of the manufacturer.

datatype_property_signatures.label: max visibility
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The upper bound of visibility in feet over the centerline of the runway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: min visibility
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The lower bound of visibility in feet over the centerline of the runway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: route ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: FAA alphanumeric identifier assigned to the route/airway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: runway ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An identifier for the runway. For physical runways, the convention is to label runways by their heading, dropping the last digit. E.g. for Liverpool, runway 9/27 is facing approximately magnetic heading 90 degrees in one direction, and 270 degrees in the opposite direction. If an airport has parallel runways, these would then be marked Left, Center and Right, e.g. 9L, 9C, 9R. For operational runways, the runway identifiers specifies one direction only: either 9 or 27 in the Liverpool example.

datatype_property_signatures.label: runway length in feet
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The length in feet of the physical runway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: runway width in feet
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The width in feet of the physical runway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: sidstar ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The FAA identifier for the SID or STAR. Typically, but not uniformly, 5 alpha characters plus a revision digit.

datatype_property_signatures.label: taxiway ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An identifier for the taxiway.

datatype_property_signatures.label: terminal ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The alphanumeric identifier of the airport terminal.

datatype_property_signatures.label: tfms monitor alert parameter
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The maximum number of aircraft permitted in a given sector at any time, per agreement between FAA and Air Traffic Controller union. MAP (Monitor Alert Parameter) is a TFMS input parameter.

datatype_property_signatures.label: tier level
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The degree number of the ARTCC tier. Tier 1 includes the central ARTCC plus all ARTCCs immediately adjoining the central ARTCC; tier 2 includes tier 1 plus all adjacent ARTCCs two steps away from the central ARTCC. And so on.

datatype_property_signatures.label: tower ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The FAA identifier for air traffic control tower.

datatype_property_signatures.label: within timezone
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The timezone identifier for the airport, where the timezone is specified as Area/Location, e.g. America/New_York.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airport arrival rate
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The arrival rate per hour set by the airport during the specified interval. This is the total number of aircraft that can arrive on all runways combined during an hour.

datatype_property_signatures.label: airport departure rate
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The departure rate per hour set by the airport during the specified interval. This is the total number of aircraft that can depart from all runways combined during an hour.

datatype_property_signatures.label: arrival demand
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of aircraft intending to arrive at an airport during the specified time period.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ASPM Flight Rules
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates what flight rule conditions the airport is operating under during the specified time period (I-instrument, V-Visual).

datatype_property_signatures.label: base altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For a given homogeonous cloud layer, this is the lowest altitude.

datatype_property_signatures.label: ceiling
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The vertical visibility (in feet) measured from the ground to the lowest cloud layer reported as broken or overcast.

datatype_property_signatures.label: cloud cover
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For a given homogenous cloud layer, the type of cloud cover present: clear, few clouds, scattered clouds, broken clouds, overcast, vertical visibility layer.

datatype_property_signatures.label: cloud type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For a given homogeneous cloud layer, the type of cloud present: towering cumulus, cumulonimbus, altocumulus castellanus.

datatype_property_signatures.label: data interval end time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the ending time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_property_signatures.label: data interval start time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the starting time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_property_signatures.label: departure demand
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of aircraft intending to depart during the specified time period.

datatype_property_signatures.label: dewpoint temperature
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The dewpoint temperature in degrees. It is the temperature at which the air can no longer hold all of its water vapor, and some of the water vapor must condense into liquid water. The dew point is always lower than (or equal to) the air temperature.

datatype_property_signatures.label: EDCT arrival hold
datatype_property_signatures.comment: EDCT (Estimated Departure Clearance Time) hold minutes at other airports arriving this airport.

datatype_property_signatures.label: EDCT departure hold
datatype_property_signatures.comment: EDCT (Estimated Departure Clearance Time) hold minutes at other airports departing this airport.

datatype_property_signatures.label: etms arrivals
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Count of arrivals at airport based on ETMS (Enhanced Traffic Management System) data.

datatype_property_signatures.label: etms arrivals
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Count of departures at airport based on ETMS (Enhanced Traffic Management System) data.

datatype_property_signatures.label: forecast issue time
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The time that the report was issued.

datatype_property_signatures.label: high wind WITI daily
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The high wind weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the winds at the airport are above a set threshold, then the high wind WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: high wind WITI hourly
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The high wind weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the winds at the airport are above a set threshold, then the high wind WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: hourly precipitation
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Recorded hourly precipitation rate at the measurement station in inches.

datatype_property_signatures.label: limited visibility distance
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The visibility distance (in miles) at the reporting station. Only applicable if data:unlimitedVisibility is False.

datatype_property_signatures.label: low ceiling WITI daily
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The low ceiling weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the ceiling at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low ceiling WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: low ceiling WITI hourly
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The low ceiling weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the ceiling at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low ceiling WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: low visibility WITI daily
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The low visibility weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (daily). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the visibility at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low visibility WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: low visibility WITI hourly
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The low visibility weather impacted traffic index (WITI) computed for the airport during the specified timeframe (hourly). WITI is an estimate of the number of flights potentially impacted due to inclement weather based on the scheduled traffic demand for a defined geographic region of the air traffic system (in this case, an airport). If the visibility at the airport is below a set threshold, then the low visibility WITI is set to the number of scheduled arrivals for that timeframe.

datatype_property_signatures.label: met condition probability
datatype_property_signatures.comment: For a forecast meteorological condition, the percent probability associated with the forecast occurrence.

datatype_property_signatures.label: metar report modifier
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Automation status information pertaining to a METAR report: AUTO indicates a fully automated report with no human intervention; COR indicates a corrected observation; no modifier indicates either human observer/reporter or automated report with human oversight.

datatype_property_signatures.label: METAR report string
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Entire text of METAR report.

datatype_property_signatures.label: metar report type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: METAR report type indicator specifies whether this report is a regularly scheduled hourly report (METAR) or a special unscheduled report (SPECI). SPECIs are issued more frequently than hourly when adverse weather conditions prevail.

datatype_property_signatures.label: metar station has precipitation sensor
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A boolean value indicating whether the reporting METAR station has a precipitation sensor.

datatype_property_signatures.label: meteorological condition status
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An indicator of whether the meteorological condition is based on actual observations (observed) or on future projections (forecast).

datatype_property_signatures.label: OAG arrival delay
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Minutes of OAG (Official Airline Guide) based arrival delay in excess of 15 minutes.

datatype_property_signatures.label: OAG gate departure delay
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Minutes of OAG (Official Airline Guide) based gate departure delay in excess of 15 minutes.

datatype_property_signatures.label: rapidity of weather change
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates how fast change is expected from the prior state to the forecast meteorological conditions: "rapid" , "gradual" , "transient".

datatype_property_signatures.label: runway status
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An indicator of whether the runway is open or closed during the specified period.

datatype_property_signatures.label: runway surface friction (mu)
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The surface friction (mu) value of the runway for the specified period. Runway surface friction is directly relevant to the braking action which will be available to an aircraft decelerating after touch down, or after a decision to reject a take off.

datatype_property_signatures.label: scheduled arrivals
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Count of scheduled arrivals. (Most probably from OAG (Official Airline Guide))

datatype_property_signatures.label: scheduled departures
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Count of scheduled departures. (Most probably from OAG (Official Airline Guide))

datatype_property_signatures.label: sea level pressure
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Sea level pressure measured under the associated meteorological conditions.

datatype_property_signatures.label: surface gust speed
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Surface gust speed measured under the associated surface wind conditions.

datatype_property_signatures.label: surface temperature
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Surface temperature measured under the associated meteorological conditions.

datatype_property_signatures.label: surface wind direction status
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Information about the direction of the wind, either fixed, varyingWithinRange, or variable.

datatype_property_signatures.label: surface wind speed
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The speed in knots of the surface wind.

datatype_property_signatures.label: taf report string
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The full text of the entire Meteorological report.

datatype_property_signatures.label: taf report type
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Type of Terminal Area Forecast (TAF) report: a routine report (TAF), an amended report (AMD), a corrected report (COR), or a delayed report (RTD). An amended TAF is issued when the current TAF no longer adequately describes the ongoing weather or the forecaster feels the TAF is not representative of the current or expected weather.

datatype_property_signatures.label: top altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The top altitude of a homogenous cloud layer.

datatype_property_signatures.label: total airborne delay
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Total airborne flight delay in minutes for this airport during the specified period.

datatype_property_signatures.label: unlimited visibility
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A binary property indicating whether the visibility conditions are unlimited.

datatype_property_signatures.label: weather intensity
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An indicator of the intensity of the weather: light, moderate, heavy.

datatype_property_signatures.label: weather phenomenon
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Describes the type of weather phenomena experienced during the specified period: drizzle, rain, snow, snow grains, ice crystals, ice pellets, hail, small hail and/or snow pellets, unknown precipitation, mist, fog, smoke, volcanic ash, widespread dust, sand, haze, spray, well-developed dust/sand whirls, squalls, funnel cloud, tornado/waterspout, sandstorm, duststorm

datatype_property_signatures.label: weather proximity
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Describes the location of the weather phenomena in relation to the reporting station: immediate proximity or in vicinity.

datatype_property_signatures.label: weather qualifier
datatype_property_signatures.comment: An additional qualifier describing the reported weather phenomenon: shallow, partial, patchy, low drifting, blowing, shower, thunderstorm, freezing.

datatype_property_signatures.label: fixed wind direction
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Steady wind direction (in degrees), when winds are fixed and not variable.

datatype_property_signatures.label: lower wind direction
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Lower bound (in degrees) of two bounding values describing a variable wind direction.

datatype_property_signatures.label: lower wind direction
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Upper bound (in degrees) of two bounding values describing a variable wind direction.

datatype_property_signatures.label: wind shear height
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The height in hundreds of feet above ground level associated with a wind shear phenomenon.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft model certainty
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A numeric measure between 0 and 1 reflecting how certain the eqp:hasAircraftModel link is to be correct between the aircraft and the model. A value of one indicates 100% certainty. A lesser value is not to be taken as a percentage, but is a heuristic similarity value taken from the scoring of the TF/IDF similarity assessment performed between the FAA aircraft make/model in the FAA registration database and ICAO make/model names used in the ontology.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft registrant
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The name of the entity that registered the aircraft with the FAA.

datatype_property_signatures.label: serial number
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The manufacturer serial number of the aircraft.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft type designator
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The type designator code for this type of aircraft (e.g., B777).

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft weight high bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The upper bound of the aircraft weight category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: aircraft weight low bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The lower bound of the aircraft weight category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: certificate issue date
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The date that an operating certificate was issued to the aircraft.

datatype_property_signatures.label: CICTT number
datatype_property_signatures.comment: CAST/ICAO Common Taxonomy Team (CICTT) identifier for this model as specified by the International Aircraft Categorisation And Identification Standard (IACIS).

datatype_property_signatures.label: engine type description
datatype_property_signatures.comment: A text description of the engine type characteristics.

datatype_property_signatures.label: manufacture year
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The year the system was manufactured.

datatype_property_signatures.label: max takeoff weight high bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The upper bound of the maximum takeoff weight for this category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: max takeoff weight low bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The lower bound of the maximum takeoff weight for this category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: mode SCode
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The unique Mode S address of the transponder aboard the aircraft. Mode S equipment on aircraft are assigned a unique ICAO 24-bit address or (informally) Mode S hex code upon national registration and this address becomes a part of the aircraft's Certificate of Registration.

datatype_property_signatures.label: model ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The string identifier of the model for this system/subsystem/assembly.

datatype_property_signatures.label: number of engines
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of engines specified for this aircraft model or found on this aircraft.

datatype_property_signatures.label: number of seats
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of seats on this aircraft.

datatype_property_signatures.label: registration number
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The aircraft FAA registration number (the tail number, or the N-Number in the US).

datatype_property_signatures.label: wake category ID
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The wake category identification character (A through F).

datatype_property_signatures.label: wing span high bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The upper bound of the wingspan for this category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: wing span low bound
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The lower bound of the wingspan for this category.

datatype_property_signatures.label: Well-Known Text geographic representation
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The WKT string representation of a location. Well-known text (WKT) is a text markup language for representing vector geometry objects on a map, spatial reference systems of spatial objects and transformations between spatial reference systems. WKT is a standards-based representation stored as an alternative to the explicit polygon boundary representation employed in the Ontology (see gen:PolygonBoundary).

datatype_property_signatures.label: altitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The altitude of a point location.

datatype_property_signatures.label: latitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The latitude of a point location.

datatype_property_signatures.label: longitude
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The longitude of a point location.

datatype_property_signatures.label: polygon height
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Specifies the length dimension of a polygonal volume.

datatype_property_signatures.label: radius
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The radius of a circular region. Note: Unfortunately, the units are currently dependent the type of circular region defined. This needs to be improved.

datatype_property_signatures.label: sequence length
datatype_property_signatures.comment: The number of items in the ordered sequence.

datatype_property_signatures.label: sequenceNumber
datatype_property_signatures.comment: Indicates the ordered position of this item within the sequence, where 1 signifies the first position in the sequence.
